title: Wispr Flow alternatives for Mac in 2026, compared with real prices
metaTitle: Wispr Flow alternatives for Mac (with real prices)
description: The best Wispr Flow alternatives for Mac compared: Superwhisper, Aqua Voice, Willow Voice and Lazur. Prices from each company's own pricing page.
intro: The main Wispr Flow alternatives on Mac are Superwhisper, Aqua Voice, Willow Voice and Lazur. The first three are dictation apps like Wispr Flow; Lazur is a voice assistant that sees your screen and dictates too.
tldr: Cheapest paid plan: Superwhisper Pro at $8.49/month, or a $249.99 lifetime license.
Offline dictation: Superwhisper and Willow Voice.
Dictation that reads your screen: Aqua Voice.
Help with your screen as well as dictation: Lazur.

products.name: Wispr Flow
products.pricing: Free plan with limited words per week; Pro $15/month or $12/month billed annually
products.summary: AI dictation that cleans up as you speak: removes filler words, adds punctuation, works in any app, 100+ languages, personal dictionary and snippets.
bestFor: You need it on Windows or your phone too

products.name: Superwhisper
products.summary: Dictation with local and cloud models, offline transcription, custom vocabulary and modes like Message and Email. You can bring your own API keys.
bestFor: You like tuning models and modes

products.name: Aqua Voice
products.pricing: Free for 1,000 words; Pro $12/month ($10 billed annually); Max $24/month ($19 billed annually)
products.summary: AI dictation with screen awareness, real-time refinement, a custom dictionary and writing styles. Works in every app.
bestFor: You want fast dictation that reads context from your screen
You need Windows or mobile too
Your team needs a BAA (Max and Business plans)

products.name: Willow Voice
products.pricing: Free Basic plan; Pro $15/month or $12/month billed annually
products.summary: Dictation with smart formatting, a dictionary that learns, writing-style matching and an offline mode.
bestFor: You mostly dictate and want it fast
You need Windows or iPhone too

products.name: Lazur
products.pricing: 3-day free trial, then Pro $18/month or Power $120/month
products.summary: A voice assistant in the Mac notch. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and it sees your screen, answers out loud, points at buttons and walks you through apps. Hold fn to dictate in any app.
bestFor: You want help with what is on your screen, not only typing
You learn new Mac apps often
You want dictation and an assistant in one app

verdict: If you like Wispr Flow and only want it cheaper, try Superwhisper. If you want offline, Superwhisper or Willow. If you want dictation that understands context, Aqua Voice. If what you really want is help with the apps on your Mac, try Lazur.

items: Need Windows or a phone too? Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, Aqua Voice and Willow all have more than Mac.
Need it offline? Superwhisper has offline models; Willow has an offline mode.
Want answers and pointing, not only typing? That is Lazur.

blocks.text: Measure your own speed first with the [typing speed test](/tools/typing-speed-test), and check any app's accuracy with the [dictation accuracy checker](/tools/dictation-accuracy-checker).

faq.question: What is the best free Wispr Flow alternative?
faq.answer: Apple Dictation is free and built into macOS. Superwhisper, Aqua Voice and Willow Voice also have free plans with limits.

faq.question: Is there a Wispr Flow alternative with a lifetime license?
faq.answer: Superwhisper lists a $249.99 lifetime Pro license on its site.

faq.question: Which alternative works offline?
faq.answer: Superwhisper offers offline models and Willow Voice has an offline mode, according to their sites.
